official_native_sonnet_human.corpus: Broad hg38 ENCODE, FANTOM5, and Basenji2-processed functional-genomics tracks; no donor-expression input

registered_crested_enformer_human.rule: A conversion cannot improve the native checkpoint's exposure classification and is a separate artifact identity.

input_eligibility.gse281364: Sequence-only retrospective MPRA direction and rank diagnostic. No MPRA outcome may select tracks, bins, windows, aggregation, or a downstream head.
input_eligibility.gse289173: Eligible only for one-time sequence inference after selection lock. Enformer has no donor or expression input, so predictions at the same allele and window are identical across donors. Signed eQTL or ieQTL prediction requires a separately frozen development-only link and direction model.
input_eligibility.gse296875: Eligible as a static sequence-track baseline or as input to a separately named development-fitted head. It cannot use same-nucleus RNA as context and is not an RNA-conditioned ATAC model.
input_eligibility.observed_context_requirement: none_supported; a fixed liver, HepG2, CAGE, DNase, or ATAC training track is not observed donor context

interpretation: The three named project sources postdate the read-only native checkpoint, so their target labels are unexposed. Reference sequence and generic functional-genomics biology remain exposed. The registered CREsted archive passed safe inventory, strict fixed-fixture restoration, deterministic repeat, output-order crosswalk, and an outcome-blind GSE281364 run, but it remains restricted and lacks a reproducible conversion plus numeric parity against official native Sonnet. It must not be treated as the official native checkpoint.

license_disposition.converted_code_and_loader: CREsted pinned internal academic, noncommercial, nontransferable terms that prohibit unapproved modification or derivatives
